Sub: Intimation about Conference Call for Investors and Analysts 
Dear Sir/ Madam,  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 including amendments thereunder; we wish to inform you that a Conference Call for Investors 
and Analysts has been organized on Thursday, 5th November 2026, at 1.30 pm (IST) to discuss the 
unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. 
The link for the conference call is enclosed herewith for your reference.  
The presentation to be discussed at the conference call will be uploaded on the website of the 
Company viz. https://www.kirloskaroilengines.com/ 
You are kindly requested to take the same on record. 
Thanking you 
Yours faithfully, 
For Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited  
 
 
Sachin Kejriwal 
Chief Financial Officer 
 
Encl.: As above. 
 
Sachin
